Welcome toSyEWflows! A newSimple yet Efficient Workflowsolution for ComfyUI

T2V Mini edition:

Just put your prompt, press Run and let the magic happen.

I2V Mini edition:

Upload picture, prompt and Run!

Recommended minimum megapixel is0.23, higher values improves quality at the cost of longer generation times

Last frames are all saved in /output/SyEW/
